versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No changes to features or behavior; documentation updated and streamlined in SKILL.md.
- All functionality remains as previously described.

- Added skill documentation (README.md) and metadata file.
- Updated documentation to clarify preserved formatting in format-only mode: now explicitly preserves tables and styles them per official font rules.
- Expanded feature list in the description: now highlights support for red headers, 发文字号/签发人, secret level markings, 主送机关 colon auto-fill, date auto-fill, attachment notes/markers, proper issuer/date placement, page numbers, font-missing warnings, and a checker script.
- Added new command-line options documentation, including support for secret-level marking, --date today, and table preservation.
- Improved guidance on official document formatting details and output checks.

- Initial release: generates or reformats Word (.docx) documents to Chinese PRC party/government official document standards.
- Supports format-only and generated shell workflows for official document types (请示、函、报告、通知等).
- Applies specific fonts, red headers, government margins, and layout rules per national and local formatting standards (GB/T 9704 and local overrides).
- Does not modify substantive wording unless asked; uses placeholders for missing metadata.
- Provides example commands for generating, formatting, and quality-checking documents via scripts.
- Requires python-docx and related scripts; checks for correctness of key formal elements (fonts, headers, numbers, etc.).
